yaml.description: Portfolio of Justin Mai, a Cal Poly Statistics graduate working across machine learning, geospatial data, and statistical modeling.

::::::::: {.hero-section .section-shell} ::::: {.hero-copy .reveal} [ Statistics · Data Science · Visualization]{.eyebrow} I'm **Justin Mai**, a Cal Poly Statistics + Data Science graduate. I build reproducible data and machine-learning workflows across geospatial vision, statistical modeling, and interactive analytics. ::: hero-actions Explore my work View resume ::: ::: {.hero-links aria-label="Social profiles"} GitHub LinkedIn ::: ::::: ::::: {.hero-visual .reveal .delay-1} :::: {.portrait-frame .interactive-card} ::: portrait-halo ::: :::: ::::: ::::::::: :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#projects .home-projects .section-shell} :::: {.section-heading .section-heading-row .home-projects-heading .reveal} ::: {} [ Selected work]{.eyebrow} ## My Work and Projects Interactive tools, analytical storytelling, and statistical research all on one page! ::: More on GitHub :::: ::::::::::::::::::::::::::: projects-stack ::::::::: {#geocam-campus-locator .project-showcase .interactive-card .reveal} :::::: project-summary ::: project-kicker 01 Geospatial machine learning ::: ## GeoCam Campus Locator A photo-based campus building identifier paired with an interactive Cal Poly explorer. The mobile app connects a React Native camera workflow to a vision pipeline built with fine-tuned OpenCLIP and SIFT-LightGlue, then returns a predicted building, confidence score, and useful campus details. ::: tag-row PythonOpenCLIPLightGlueReact Native ::: ::: project-actions Explore campus demo View source ::: :::::: :::: {.project-preview-shell .geocam-preview} ::: browser-chrome Interactive campus explorer ::: :::: ::::::::: ::::::::: {#census-data-explorer .project-showcase .interactive-card .reveal} :::::: project-summary ::: project-kicker 02 Interactive application ::: ## Census Data Explorer An interactive Shiny application for exploring census income data and building animated visualizations. Choose inputs, compare patterns, and generate a GIF directly in the app. ::: tag-row RShinyCensus dataAnimation ::: ::: project-actions Open live app ::: :::::: :::: {.project-preview-shell .app-preview} ::: browser-chrome Interactive preview ::: :::: ::::::::: :::::::::::: {.project-showcase .interactive-card .reveal} :::::: project-summary ::: project-kicker 03 Statistical research ::: ## Investigating Butterfly Habitats This study uses multilevel regression to examine how temperature, humidity, seasonal variation, and other environmental conditions affect the likelihood of butterflies being present in an area. ::: tag-row Multilevel modelsEcologyResearch ::: ::: project-actions Read full report ::: :::::: :::::: {.project-art .art-butterfly aria-hidden="true"} ::: {.wing .wing-left} ::: ::: {.wing .wing-right} ::: ::: butterfly-body ::: [MODEL / ECOLOGY]{.art-label} :::::: ::: {#butterfly-preview .inline-preview hidden="hidden"} ::: :::::::::::: ::::::::::::::::::::::::::: :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: ::::: {.off-clock .section-shell .reveal} ::: {} [Away from the data]{.eyebrow} ## Snow, walls, and games. :::

When I'm off the clock, you'll usually find me snowboarding, indoor bouldering, or unwinding with a game.

::: {.off-clock-icons aria-hidden="true"} ::: ::::: :::: {.cta-section .section-shell .reveal} ::: {} [Let's connect]{.eyebrow .eyebrow-light} ## Have a question or an interesting dataset? I'm always happy to talk about statistics, data visualization, or a project worth exploring. ::: Get in touch ::::
